signal: Monograph's 2026 benchmark report drew on platform data from 13,000+ architects at 1,800+ firms and flagged a widening chargeability gap

email.body1:
Blake, saw Monograph's 2026 benchmark pull data from 13,000-plus architects at 1,800-plus firms and flag a widening chargeability gap.

For RevOps, that kind of data motion usually exposes the signal-to-action gap: in-market firms surface faster than reps can research, write, and follow up. Our AI SDR handles that autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Monograph off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Blake, quick follow-up for Monograph.

For RevOps, the hard part is rarely the signal, it is the latency from signal to booked meeting, plus the data hygiene that keeps it measurable. Most teams lose lift in that handoff.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Blake, last bit of proof for Monograph.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Monograph's reply rate likely compares to other vertical SaaS startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Blake, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-meeting latency without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A benchmark cycle is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your RevOps motion? I will tailor it to Monograph either way.
